rule: About 10 h of published episodes that carry Astra labels, drawn for the Sol 6.1 tranche: a third of the hours per capture modality and an equal share per dataset within it (a dataset short of its share gives the rest to its modality's others); within a dataset, tasks are visited round robin in seeded order and one random episode is taken per task per pass until the budget. The episodes of main.json, of the example annotations and of the gate are excluded. Each episode's line is its line in the dataset's episode list (configs/slices), the input of python -m prepare.
